notes.title: Update 1.3 - Season 2: Beast Feast
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/f8ddc220502db0d7f8e9dd3cf494c44986591ca2.png[/img]
Howdy good beasts and men!
The 1.3 update is here! And it’s a big one: New season, two new playable beasts, game cinematic intro, final boss, ranking reset, over 30 new items to get and more! Let’s dive into some details, shall we?

[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added equivalent of the game cost, as Fireflies, given as reward for first 10 level ups.
[*] Added free DLC containing full [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2358810/FurryFury_Soundtrack/]FurryFury Soundtrack[/url].
[*] New (2nd) season: Beast Feast! Much bigger than the first one, with more rewards for both free and golden pass. All in the spirit of the beasts’ greatest passion: eating. Also, now fulfilling the season and daily quests progresses the season pass more than before. But beware, this time there is a deadline.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/06a637200d7413a241bd10ed23f43cef5f14abd6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] The Leaderboard has been reset. And progressing through leagues rebalanced: now you need more fame to progress, but you also gain more for winning, while losing remains similar. Who’s gonna get to the Legends league first this time? Share the screenshot on steam hub when you do.
[*] Added a cinematic intro. It’s on the adventure map, after the tutorial (and also on [url=https://youtu.be/EGJdNyZW8-Q]youtube[/url]).
[*] 7th (final) chapter of the adventure: a boss fight and the final page of the story comic. Tip: it's cold out there.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/558d4d6976b703e54f6cfffd563ebccc644e751f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] 2 new playable characters: one of which can only be obtained by finishing the whole adventure. And the second one, well... see for yourself.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/69e4f170f422c968621331f6e39cd39fbcb4193d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Local/couch co-op: name it however you want, or just grab two controllers and play together instead. Works in adventure, duels and even 2v2.
[*] New calendar event with even more handsome rewards than before. Win a game every day for 20 days out of 30.
[*] More unlockable stuff (including 2 legendaries): 10 new skins, 7 showoffs, 3 ghosts, 3 victory backgrounds, 9 texts, 6 avatars, 
[*] New main menu background. Hope you’ll like it.
[*] 6 new achievements, and handsome rewards for completing them.
[*] 2 jungle arenas join the versus rooster.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/42d6396c80acc0ffa362018fb35c3973b4e0e3cd.png[/img]
[h2]Changes/Upgrades/Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved AI: it’s less suicidal and more aware of area abilities.
[*] Adventure difficulty changed (decreased) to achieve an overall smoother experience: Easier at the beginning and at the end, well… the end it’s still difficult ;) . There are also more turns to get stars, and an achievement for collecting them so…  try to catch them all!
[*] Added FX for completed spoils (quests, rank ups, level ups and achievements) and changed spoils background.
[*] Improved translations of all languages,
[*] Improved range visibility and precision of the artifacts skill.
[*] Added ‘avatar’ to avatar names to not confuse them with skins.
[*] Added a ‘check details’ button to some news popups, which leads directly to related sub-menu.
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Found and eliminated some seemingly random freezes (probably some of the last of their kind).
[*] Sometimes Victory Chest doesn’t appear in Shop after unlocking Victory Customization until the game is restarted - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes game soft locks when opening the chest with the last unlockable item - Fixed.
[*] Wrong text when unlocking golden pass in some languages - Fixed,
[*] Sometimes spoils display wrong achievement progress - Fixed.
[/list]

That’s it for this update. Stay tuned for the next one and meanwhile…
Let’s roll!

Marcin "Tinek" Michalski

notes.title: BIG UPDATE... is coming
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/6ab94765aa579fe4b37d59a7ae8a664bf71d712c.png[/img]
Howdy good beasts and men!
We have an important announcement to make: the next [b]update (v1.3) is complete[/b]. And it’s gonna be awesome (personal opinion). Two new playable beasts, new (much bigger) season, final chapter of the adventure and finally: couch co-op… to name a few. Also, this update will mark the release of the Nintendo Switch version, fully cross platform like all of our other ports.

This is not the only announcement. [b]FurryFury is switching from free2play model to premium[/b]. It will be paid on all existing platforms as well as on the Switch. We believe that the game can reach new audiences this way, gain proper recognition and help us develop it further. Also, by being a paid game, we will be able to participate in platforms’ promotions and discounts to gain visibility, which was impossible with f2p.

We are aware that this change may seem controversial. So to make it fair, [b]if you’ve already added FurryFury to your library, you will keep it forever[/b] (and all the upcoming updates as well). And for those, who haven’t downloaded it yet: Hurry Up! You can still grab it for free until February 17th 2023 08:00 AM EST.
That’s not all. With the upcoming update 1.3, [b]the equivalent of the game cost in Fireflies (80+) will be given as rewards for the first 10 level ups (even for those who got the game for free)[/b].
Please, spread the word, so others don’t miss out.

Next stop: update 1.3. We will announce the exact date soon.
And meanwhile: Let’s roll!

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Snowman Hunt
notes.notes:

HoHoHo good beasts and men!
The 1.2 update is here! And in it: new multipart event, new winter skins, new neutral beast, match UI redesign, lots of QoL improvements and more. Without further ado…
[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Our first steam DLC: Beast Pack. It unlocks all the current beasts, and also adds a unique golden frame to your avatar. Gold not only stands out nicely in leaderboards, but also indicates that you have supported the game. Check out the details on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2232670/FurryFury__Beast_Pack/]dlc steam page[/url].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/f35e0de318277f4feab2815e87cd5d4018b78f12.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New, multipart event: Snowmen Hunt. This time event is divided into four parts, the more snowmen you will smash, the more handsome rewards you will get. With final reward being the first and only legendary victory background (spoiler: it’s fullscreen and awesome).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/e4cf43b73f84fb44cb036ff7b9de8b49634cd06f.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Redesigned in-match ui. It now emphasizes your beast, so you don’t need to select it to check its stats and skills. We also changed the timer menu to expandable, so the timer takes less space on the screen. The character card is also changed; it now takes the same amount of space, no matter how many skills a beast have. And lastly, all the beasts are color coded for easier team differentiation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/a6d347ea626ebc3962b25b5f489e687f8782cf53.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/56c90cc88fb612c8b358e147e60b15a9cd7a047b.png[/img]

[*] New daily quests: for playing as Rikiki and Garrr, and also a few variations of existing quests with bigger requirements but also bigger rewards.
[*] New neutral creature: Fro - the spiky one. There he comes, to make your combos even more harmful.
[*] New winter-themed thingies to get: 3 beast skins, 1 show-off and 5 avatars.
[/list]
[h2]Changes/Upgrades/Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] AI improvements: it thinks faster and performs less self-harming moves.
[*] We removed bots completely from 2v2 matchmaking.
[*] Redesigned gamepad navigation: you can now navigate around all the menus with the stick, instead of being forced to use separate buttons as shortcuts. We also improved selection visibility which is especially helpful during the match.
[*] Changed the rewards of daily quests, instead of all giving the same rewards, now some of them give only Grubs, and some only Fireflies (but more of each).
[*] Simplified and shortened the tutorial.
[*] Match spoils now display the progression of the achievement which is the closest to complete (instead of a random progressed achievement).
[*] Stats on beasts (during match) are turned on by default.
[*] Removed the limit of messages sent per turn.
[*] Removed bonus damage cap from Cruelick “Must Bounce” skill.

[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Found and fixed a few more in-match freeze causes (thanks to your reports).
[*] Sometimes game hangs (and needs to be restarted) after network disconnection - Fixed (it goes back to menu now).
[*] Winstreak sometimes resets when the opponent leaves match very early - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes adventures don't progress the campaign when finished after restarting them - Fixed.
[*] “Match ended prematurely” sometimes doesn’t show for all players in a 2v2 match - Fixed.
[*] The nests of two different Rikikis can overlap - FIxed (it spawns in the closest free location).
[*] Sometimes the ‘back’ button in Avatars sub-menu doesn’t work - Fixed.
[*] Spoils sometimes doesn’t display a new league badge when advancing to a new league - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes beast cards in the menu show wrong rarity - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes, in settings, a selection on slider doesn’t appear - Fixed.
[*] The "buy" button on Chest of “Unpredictable Contents” sometimes remain, even though you have all possible rewards - Fixed.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/4b48642af9f505e5572ff3a0b761129b822d11c3.png[/img]
And that’s it for now. Big thanks to you, the community, for playing, sharing ideas and reporting bugs. Have a marry Christmass Y'all!
   Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Meet Garrr!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/8974c3888214f50f154ea48874e9f1d4ff854bc6.png[/img]
Howdy good beasts and men!
It’s been a while, but the 1.1 update is here! And in it: new playable Beast, new Adventure chapter, a Daily Wins event, new skins, victory backgrounds and much more. Let’s dive into the details!

[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New adventure chapter: The Caves. Four arenas filled with darkness, a new breed of annoying enemies, new challenges and a pink (?) boss. The story is almost at its peak; expect the final chapter in update 1.2.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/1fb88864b04446139cc6e72c44b2b950e624cdc9.png[/img]
[list]
[*] New playable beast: Garrr! He has some serious anger management issues, getting bonus Attack each time he gets hurt. Apart from that, he loves all plants, especially flowers. Guess which ones are his favourite.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/cb9551a967caa87fc20b5ec0b9acd3a97f29e0ab.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Two new events; a regular one, and a ‘Calendar of daily victories’. Claim rewards every day, try to win systematically to get the final reward, but don’t linger, there is only a month to do it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/908a46c245fe62109df01374dad4f78ca613e1e5.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We added support for gamepads: just plug and play, switch anytime you want.
[*] 20 new cards: 3 victory backgrounds, 5 beast skins, 8 move effects (including a Legendary) and more.
[*] Two arenas added to the Versus pool: Invisible Bridge and Carrot Field at night.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/10d057e9327817b2eec65b431fa1ebda22bb2d38.png[/img]

[h2]Changes/Upgrades/Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can preview the beasts you don’t have (requested by the community).
[*] ‘Play Again’ skips the intro dialogues now.
[*] Shortened the loading time after finishing the match.
[*] Changed the way of acquiring beasts. Many of you complained about the RNG of getting beasts, so we decided to make both beasts and their skins buyable. Just choose the one you want and buy it, the price is the same as the chest. To make it a bit more challenging and balanced, the new and epic ones are more expensive. Hope you’ll enjoy it.
[*] Fireflies packs boost: we removed the smallest pack, and increased the number of Fireflies in all the others. Prices untouched.
[*] Adventure made easier: On the bridge arenas, GrimFinale comes later and The Egg has more Health, boss in adventure 3 bonus damage skill replaced by a weaker one, more time to get stars in adventures 1-12.
[*] Removed Brew as a possible neutral beast on Hex arena and added extra rock in 1v1 (to speed things up a bit).
[*] Bubak’s Health increased from 12 to 13.
[*] Zolf’s Health reduced from 14 to 13, Aim increased from 9 to 10.
[*] Maximum win streak bonus reduced from infinite to 10.
[*] Changed ‘Friends’ and platform icons so they look more intuitive.
[*] Increased the level cap from 70 to 100.
[*] improved currency gaining effects.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Friends connecting and joining/inviting issues - Fixed (thanks to your reports, we managed to find and fix several causes).
[*] Rarely, owned items can disappear for some players - Fixed.
[*] Rare in-match freezes - Fixed.
[*] Some achievements don't change the image when unlocked - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes Zolf can move through other Zolf totems - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes, some cards are doubled in the My Beast menu - Fixed.
[*] In rare cases, move prediction shows where you’ll stop, but you go a bit further - Fixed.
[*] Unable to get the Broken Zolf skin from the forgotten package - Fixed.
[*] When changing language during tutorial, the current text bubble is not translated - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes info clouds aren’t scaling to contain the text, sometimes close to early - Fixed.
[*] Skill description popup sometimes covers up the skill icons - Fixed.
[*] Some sound effects in the menu ignore the Master Volume setting - Fixed.
[*] Clicking currency icons in the Missions sub-menu does not open the Shop - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes win streak shows wrong bonus fame amount - Fixed.
[*] On desert arenas, Bubak’s ray goes under the arena edges - Fixed.
[*] Move effects names are sometimes in capital letters, and sometimes not - Fixed.
[*] ‘Refresh Quest’ button has too big hitbox - Fixed.
[/list]

That’s it for now. Thank you for playing, sharing your thoughts and reporting bugs.
Coming up next: Nintendo Switch port, new Beast, final boss fight, and more. Let’s roll!
   Marcin (Tinek) Michalski

notes.title: FurryFury 1.0 - Release the Beasts!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/9bff0766a6cf2ffabdacdf26182f7325c9aa0aee.png[/img]
Howdy good people (and beasts),
The time has come; after 2 years, we’re coming out of EarlyAccess! It doesn’t mean the end of production, not by any means. But it’s a great occasion to drop a juicy update. Featuring new playable beast, neutral creature, adventure chapter, boss, and much much more. Let’s jump right into it!

[h2]New Stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] iOS premiere! We release the update 1.0 simultaneously on PC, Android, and now, also on iOS, maintaining cross-playability between all those platforms,
[*] New playable beast: Rikiki! He’s a wilder ratling, creates a friend-boosting enemy-hurting nest which stays on the arena until the end of match, and also shoots spikes in all directions when angry.

notes.title: Update 0.8 - Stay hydrated
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/7c4c883433f6e908c732cf445e8c7d19c51acaa1.png[/img]
Howdy  good people,
The time has finally come! I'm excited to reveal to you the NEW update 0.8 - the biggest one yet. We have rebuilt the whole UI, completely reimagined adventure mode, wrote the new AI from scratch (it kicks butts and chew bubble gum), moved backend to our own server and generally built the foundation for the future updates. We also thought that this is a great time to experiment a bit and test out some new ideas. Let's jump right into it, shall we?

[h2]Brand new Adventure mode[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adventure mode was rebuild from scratch, turning into story-driven campaign. It can still be played both solo and in co-op and the progression is now separated.
[*] In this update we reveal the first chapter of Adventure, featuring 3 new, unique arenas and the first boss. More to come in the future updates.
[*] The adventure is now presented on a hand-drawn world map, adding the sense of place to the story. And the story is presented by comics between fights. Enemies during the fights has also more things to say.
[*] Updated tutorial mission: it's more readable and easier to grasp. And also features a new characters: Shmashrul - the tribe elder (teacher) and a Dummy (Training Dummy).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/eefe8d2d12d5bc73a7b8b950efd8f9f5bc642d8a.png[/img]

[h2]New menu and match UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] It was a lot of work, but we think it was totally worth it. The new menu is bigger, less cluttered, easier to read, navigate through and... prettier. And importantly for us, it's expandable.
[*] Improved beast customization: we added real-time preview of the move effects, improved clouds setup (simply click on cloud you want to edit), separated beasts from their skins and added detailed view for the beasts.
[*] Added more stats to Player screen: separate win ratio for 1v1 and 2v2, added "favourite beast" stat (showing the most played beast and their stats), adventure progression and best ever ranking score.
[*] Added details section to ranking, explaining the scoring for different leagues.
[*] Match UI was also redesigned. It now takes less space on the screen, even though all the elements are bigger (magic). We put the timer back in the middle and added info about stars requirements (to easily keep track during the match). Characters' records also display their names now.
[*] Pre-match and post-match screens have also been redesigned. Many of you complained about their readability. Now you can clearly see, who is in which team, you can also see the adventure enemies in pre-match, as well as in the post-match after lost battle.
[*] We separated Spoils screen and rewards, and also added option to "play again" so you don't have to go back to menu between matches.
[*] New section in Options: "News". You can find a roadmap for upcoming updates there.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/2fb4795b073df9f3a7ad722db29259a821be769c.png[/img]

[h2]New AI and... Bots[/h2]
[list]
[*] Yes, bots. Before you roll your eyes, let me explain. We added bots for two reasons: firstly, because we want to improve the AI as much as possible and what better way to do it other than letting you play with them. Secondly, to give players a chance to experience the game even when there is nobody around to play with. Please note: we don't want bots to mimic humans and trick players into thinking that they play against another player. You can recognize a bot by his name, which is simply the name of the character. In matchmaking, after 40s, if the match will not be found, bots will fill out all the empty seats and the game will begin. So again, if you don't want to play with bots, stop searching before 40s.
[*] There are various AI behaviours; a Darkling in Adventure mode will play a bit different that the bot replacing disconnected player.
[*] There are also different AI levels for each league, so event the ranked match against bots should feel appropriately challenging.
[*] Bots are aware of their skills and the situation on the arena. They may perform combos, hit enemies outside of their line of sight and even activate and take advantage of arenas' mechanics.
[*] We will further improve and balance the AI. Your feedback is most appreciated.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/cb08629574d5b65becc873e8f698bdd3bee71a23.png[/img]

[h2]New rewards system[/h2]
[list]
[*] We decided to replace the custom DLC by adding second currency: Fireflies. This way all the upgrades will be available in-game for in-game currency. So for instance, the "unlock of victory screen customizations" is now available as an in-game purchase. We discovered that this approach is more transparent to the players and gives us more creative freedom. Transactions will be still handled by Steam.
[*] Players who bought a DLC, will keep their unique Show-off, and will also receive Fireflies in quantity equivalent of a 9,99$ bundle. They will however lose the XP bonus.
[*] Players can unlock everything without spending real money. Imagine Fireflies being a rare currency, where Grubs (called Demibugs before) would be a common one. It is possible to acquire both of them for in-game activities (like doing daily quests) however the Fireflies will drop in smaller quantities.
[*] New Chest in Shoppe: (requested by players) "Chest of Unearthly Creatures", guaranteeing a new Beast as a reward.
[*] Added descriptions to chests, showing drop chances of certain rarity types.
[*] We plan to add more purchase options to the Shoppe with future updates.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/4d542bb105627eeae02551f35171cb590317c001.png[/img]

[h3]More New Stuff:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New event, featuring first Legendary animated skin for Pearbear.
[*] Playable character Darkling replaced by Bluzard. His stats and skills were rebalanced and his final ability changed to Thunderstorm, which upgrades his other skills. Thanks for pointing out his weaknesses.
[*] New matchmaking: it searches for the players of similar Fame, and prioritize the ones who wait the longest. Also features fancy searching animation and pro tips ;)
[*] New cards to acquire: 3 texts, skin for Mummean.
[*] Notifications now have numbers, showing the amount of new items.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/c1fe5a835530ab74a32f063858ed5df6d32d1c92.png[/img]

[h3]Changes / balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We switched the backend from cloud servers to our own server. It helps us greatly with data control and analysis, potential bug finding/fixing, and it's a necessary step on the path towards our future plans. The only thing you'll notice right now is that players ranking scores will not be shown until they launch the game after this update.
[*] We removed option to play casual games. All now counts towards the player stats and affect fame. The only exception is "sparring 1v1" against your teammate; it doesn't affect fame and stats, but also will not progress any quests or events.
[*] Quests and events now takes slightly more time to complete, but offer better rewards.
[*] Daily quests refresh every 23h (instead of 24h).
[*] Changed quest about playing with friend into playing 2vs2.
[*] Level cap increased to 35.
[*] Beasts doesn't deal damage to teammates, never (before they did during the opposing team turn).
[*] All playable beasts have +1 Health.
[*] Fuzz-ball explosion damage increased to 3 (from 2).
[*] Shi gets her first skill at 1 Fury (instead of 2).
[*] Mummean gets his second skill at 5 Fury (instead of 4), but it steals more life.
[*] You can open "My Beast" menu by clicking on the beast in main menu (requested by players).
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Skull curse on skull arena sometimes activated wrongly after a skull death - Fixed.
[*] Collision of destroyed barriers and chests would sometimes stay until the end of turn - Fixed.
[*] Sometimes displayed move trajectory after hitting the rooted Babowacky was wrong - Fixed.
[*] Bluzard's (old Darkling) Thunderclap skill area did not dissapear after his death - Fixed.
[*] Wolfling's Bite skill effect sometimes not appearing - Fixed.
[*] When player had 6+ skills, they were very small and sticked out of the character card - Fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Known issues:[/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.97 - Faster, Stronger, Better

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/22397694d302d9ed3e7aaa64b9f299d78aedaf9d.jpg[/img]
Hello again,
A week turned into month, and I apologize for that. But we got this; the FurryFury revolution starts here! As foretold, the game went through huge technical upgrade, greatly improving networking code and game mechanics. For you this means absolutely NO LAG during movement, and super precise and easy aiming. Let's see the details, shall we?

[h2]New, better netcode.[/h2]
[list]
[*] I decided to switch to a third party networking solution, resigning from uNet completely. Thanks to that communication between players is twice as fast as before.
[*] Introduced host-migration, so if someone disconnects from the match, the control of his Beast is given to AI, and match can be finished. Still, if you are the only player left, you will be automatically annouced the winner, so no worries, you'll not play against bots :). It's mostly for 2vs2 matches where 1 disconnection was breaking the game for everyone else.
[*] There is practically no lag during the move. The calculations are performed locally, and synced only in certain moments, thanks to the redesigned move prediction system.
[*] Matchmaking should be more reliable. It's proven to be in my local tests but You need to test it in the battlefield :P. Note: Right now preparing co-op match takes around 5s so be patient (I will try to decrease it).
[/list]

[h2]New, better move prediction system.[/h2]
[list]
[*] The unity build-in physics was replaced with my own custom, fully deterministic, simplified physics system.
[*] Greatly improved aiming precision. Now changing Speed does not affect the bounce directions.
[*] Game is now framerate independent since it doesn't rely on physics anymore. This means elimination of most of the asynchronisation bugs (maybe even all of them, but you need to test it :P), and also elimination of lower match performance caused by somebody's slower internet or pc.
[*] The beasts bounce better of one another when colliding on small angles. Before they were kind of sliding off.
[*] The bounce prediction icon now shows exact position of the bounce. This helps a lot especially when aiming at other beast, to determine the outcome direction.
[/list]

[h3]More upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added effects to Ghost spawn and attack skill.
[*] Maggots in Sand Arena no longer intersect with one another.
[*] Spike wall in Skull Arena now destroy bottles and chests.
[*] Improved Grim Finale fog effect on Sand Arena.
[*] Position of Dark Cloud effect (skill of Darkling) is now slightly randomized to better hide the position of the beast.
[*] - small balance changes.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sometimes stats (Aim, Speed, Attack) changed by some effects would not return to their proper values after effect wears off - fixed.
[*] Sometimes you could get stuck in tutorial when died during the last step - fixed.
[*] Moving spike wall on Skull Arena would sometimes damage the same beast twice - fixed.
[*] When in team, teammate prediction path wouldn't refresh until you move your cursor - fixed.
[*] Skill Pacifist touch (of SHE beast) would sometimes decrease the Attack of teammates - fixed.
[*] Beasts rotating randomly at the end of move - fixed.
[*] Wrong description of Focus potion (+3 Aim, +3 Speed) - fixed.
[*] Dialog cloud send by player sometimes appear multiple times = fixed.
[*] Event progress went over the max value for some players - fixed.
[*] When quiting match in progress, the sound of match finish would play - fixed.
[/list]

[h3]What's next?[/h3]

And as always, thank you for playing and stay safe.

notes.title: Physics and Networking Revolutions - coming soon
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34695782/fcf49d40d2594ce0d371e437e4abc1dadb574eb9.jpg[/img]
Howdy good people, a little announcement:
FurryFury is receiving two major technical upgrades:

1. The whole net-code has been rewritten from scratch. There were many complains about the current state of network solutions quality. And since Unity abandoned the system some time ago already, and soon their relay servers will be shut down completely, I decided to switch to a third party networking solution. I managed to implement it already and must say that performance is much better, not mentioning the back-end.

2. The whole simulation and physics movement has been rewritten from scratch. I thought it was good time for that, since all net code is being rewritten anyway. The unity build in physics was replaced with my own custom, fully deterministic, simplified physics system. Thanks to that there is much less lag (more stuff can be calculated locally), and much more precision when aiming.

I am very excited for both of those changes, and I believe that they will not only greatly improve player experience, but will also be a solid foundation for easier and faster contents updates and features implementations. However, because they touch nearly every aspect of the game, implementing and troubleshooting them requires time.

All the changes will go live within a week, so please arm yourselves in just a little bit more patience :).
Cheers!
